comments.text: UK video creator, another geography lover here.  But on this one your European (yes,  _European_  ) is showing.  What I’ve studied as an American yielded a very different answer to your Why.  So Switzerland is surrounded by mountains.  As we say here, Big woop.  Or, La dee dah.  You contradict yourself because after stating Napoleon took the country, you describe how it was just too hard for Hitler to take it.  It was not about geography or the Swiss belatedly fortifying themselves.  Hitler had his money there.  His generals had their money there.  His Nazi loyalists who survived and fled to Argentina had their money there.  How in the world else did residents of a ruined country have the funds to flee Europe, cross an ocean, and start a new life?  Most tragic of all many Jews had their money there.  When survivors of the camps sought their families’ money in Swiss banks after the war, the Swiss pled “banking secrecy” and gave back nothing.  They still plead “banking secrecy” and judge others while to this day fail to look for an accounting within.  At least Germany over the decades has paid reparations to Israel.  Neutrality is a great excuse for fraud and graft.  I have no respect for a nation that cowers behind “neutrality” to hide its WWII and post-WWII crimes.  This information is well known in the States.  Do you not know of it in the UK?  Or in the rest of Europe?
